YATES KEITH ALLIANCE’S OBJECTION TO APPLICANTS' OBJECTIONS TO CERTAIN
  INTERVENORS' EXHIBITS LISTED IN ATTACHMENT A OF SOAH ORDER NO. 30

      NOW COMES Yates Keith Alliance and files this Objection to Applicants' Objections

to Certain Intervenors' Exhibits Listed in Attachment A of SOAH Order No. 30 wherein

Applicants erroneously allege that Yates Keith Alliance failed to upload Yates Keith Exhibits

1-13 to Egnyte. Per the attached Exhibit A, these exhibits were timely uploaded to Egnyte on

June 3, 2026.
